description: Vertical abstract canvas.  Whitish mostly with hues of greenish blue over the flatness of the surface.  In lower left corner a sharp black streak, and in the lower right other angular black, blue, and reddish formations.  In the upper right a black-reddish streak.  These intrusions are all small in proportion to the blank and shallowness of the space.
